newsitem.title: USA: ComEd 1,105 MW Byron nuke at full power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd 1,105 MW Byron nuke at full power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's Byron nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full power as of early Monday following a power reduction for repairs, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Byron, Ill., cut electricity output to 20 percent of capacity on Thursday to replace a pressure switch on a feedwater isolation valve.
Byron 2 ramped up power through the weekend and was running at 100 percent of capacity as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The adjacent Byron nuclear power unit 1, which also has a capacity of 1,105 megawatts, was operating at 97 percent of capacity, NRC said.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
